trace.checkNote: Every numeral in model text must match a fact sent or a calculator result. A miss rejects the reply; the model may get one retry, then the fixed wording is used.
trace.factsNotSent: Facts made for the model, not sent because it was not asked
trace.factsCaption: Facts sent, with value, unit and id
trace.factsMadeCaption: Facts made for the model, with value, unit and id
trace.noFacts: No facts were sent, because the model was not asked.
trace.refusedWhy: The model did reply, but its reply was not used because it
trace.refusedNote: A refused reply is never kept or shown, so it cannot pass for advice.
trace.replyNote: The reply is checked against a schema. Text from it is shown as plain text, never as page code.
trace.noReply: There is no model reply for this answer.
trace.noSource: no source record on this page
trace.cached: Reused from a few minutes ago. The same request was answered in the last five minutes, so the model was not asked again.

madeBy.model: The model chose and worded the steps from candidates that code had already worked out.
madeBy.rules: Fixed rules wrote the words from the same candidates that code worked out.
madeBy.fixed_reply: A reply written in advance. The question was not sent to the model.

fallback.disabled: No model key is set on this server.
fallback.quota: The model has used up its free quota for now.
fallback.timeout: The model took too long to answer.
fallback.invalid_reply: The model replied in a shape the app does not accept.
fallback.upstream: The model service failed to answer.
fallback.rate_limited: Your network asked the model too often in the last minute. Try again in a minute.
fallback.daily_cap: The app has reached its daily limit of model calls.
fallback.number_check_failed: The model used a number that is not in the facts, so its wording was not used.

refused.schema: was not in the shape the app accepts
refused.script: used letters from a script other than English or Hindi
refused.link: contained a link, an email address or a phone number
refused.numbers: used numbers the app did not supply
refused.quotes: quoted words that are not the official text
refused.treatment: gave advice on treating symptoms or illness
refused.unplaced: listed phrases that are not in what was typed
refused.name: repeated a name from what was typed
refused.label: put a number in the name of an activity
refused.measure: gave a distance, room size, purifier rating or rider count that was not typed
refused.ids: named steps the app did not offer
refused.one_place: chose two steps for the same activity
refused.numbers_dropped: left out a number or time the notice needs
refused.too_long: was longer than one printed page

check.passed: Passed. Every number in the reply matched a fact or a calculator result.
check.failed: Failed, so the reply was not used.
check.not_run: Not run, because no model text is shown.

callFailure.unknown_tool: Not a calculator the app has.
callFailure.failed: The calculator could not work it out.
